test_cases.title: Remove a product from the cart on the Cart page
preconditions: The cart contains at least one product.
steps: Add a product to the cart.
Select the Remove action for the cart item.
Observe the cart immediately after removal.
test_cases.expected_result: The selected product is removed from the cart, the cart badge count updates, and the cart contents are refreshed without leaving stale entries behind.

story_requirements: Customers should be able to remove previously added products from their shopping cart.
The cart badge, cart contents, and product actions shall be updated accordingly.

test_cases.title: Remove a product from the Inventory page
preconditions: The cart contains at least one product.
steps: Log in and navigate to the Inventory page.
Add a product to the cart.
Use the Remove action on the product card or cart entry from the Inventory view.
Navigate to the cart and confirm the product is no longer listed.
test_cases.expected_result: The product is removed from the cart from the Inventory page and the cart badge, cart contents, and actions reflect the new state immediately.

story_requirements: The application shall allow users to remove products from the cart from both the Inventory page and Cart page.
The cart badge, cart contents, and product actions shall be updated accordingly.

test_cases.title: Remove one of multiple cart entries without affecting the others
steps: Log in and add two products to the cart.
Remove one product while leaving the other in the cart.
Inspect the remaining product and the product count.
test_cases.expected_result: Only the selected product is removed; the remaining item stays in the cart and the badge count reflects the correct reduced total.

story_requirements: Customers should be able to remove previously added products from their shopping cart.
The cart badge and cart contents shall remain consistent after a partial removal.
